title: Woodland Footstep ABC
hook: The quiet woods keep answering softly.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one clear beat with arrangement thinned
visualStyle: warm 3D woodland storybook, moss green and bark brown, friendly animals, dappled light, isolated foreground subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child walking softly enough to notice tiny woodland sounds before seeing their sources
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: reset the listening rule: step, stop, hear, then name
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: soft 4/4 walking pulse with leaf-crunch rests
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written sound-and-texture observations; facts stay concrete while sound words recur only where the object can honestly support them
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: listen cue -> one silent recall beat -> target -> one quiet safe gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. wood-flute or pizzicato leaf answers between target phrases
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: wood-flute or pizzicato leaf answers between target phrases
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make the alphabet feel like a quiet woodland walk heard as much as seen: leaf-crunch, bark-whisper, wing-burst, paw-step and woodpecker drum guide attention without turning the forest into noise.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child walks softly and listens for small sound clues; recurring language uses crunch, hush, rustle, tap, drum, whisper and sudden silence.
semanticArc: trees and bark shape the soundscape
the walk ends with the forest quiet again
forbiddenGenericLanguage: woodland friends come walk with me
